svg.title: Surprise Bills in the Wild by the Dollar
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-surprise-bill-dollar-ranges; chapter number: 2; title: Surprise Bills in the Wild by the Dollar; subtitle: Billed, allowed, wiped, and trigger amounts from real patient cases; chart type: horizontal_bars; unit: USD; bars: label: Ground ambulance ride, allowed to billed; min: 1340; max: 3180; typical: 1840; display: $1,340 allowed; $3,180 billed; $1,840 balance bill; label: Unmet out-of-network deductible; min: 12000; max: 12000; typical: 12000; display: $12,000 deductible absorbed the allowed amount; label: Appendectomy bill, wiped to total; min: 9800; max: 14238; typical: 9800; display: $9,800 of $14,238 wiped within 6 weeks; label: Uninsured dispute trigger over estimate; min: 400; max: 400; typical: 400; display: $400 over the good faith estimate; label: Uninsured dispute filing fee; min: 25; max: 25; typical: 25; display: $25 fee within 120 days of the first bill; caption: The helicopter is protected and the road is not, while a Help Desk complaint can erase the illegal portion of an in-network facility bill.; assumptions note: Each bar is a separate reported case or rule; min and max mark the low and high dollar points of that case, and typical marks the amount the patient faced or recovered.; note: Attributed to AS DESIGNED | Risk & Insurance Stories (w_lpas-cNkc), Bill Fighter (OWN7CBskcIQ), and Law Unpacked (0NouMpFWLHI).
